notes.title: Endless Mode + modified HUD + transitions + more
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here's a fresh update for the game:

[list]
[*]Changed the disposition of the HUD elements on the main game screen (as suggested by CLicKz on our community HUB)
[*]Re-included the pause button for those who plays using mostly the mouse
[*]Decreased the required level for the "Difficulty Supreme" achievement to 20
[*]Fix quit option not working on the Powerup Selection screens
[*]Screen transition animations
[*]Hover effect on menus
[/list]

Hope you enjoy it! If you have suggestions be free to request! I love to update my games using community feedbacks.

notes.title: Demon Purge Saga out now on Early Access!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I have just published a new game on Early Access: Demon Purge Saga. It is as match-3 game with exorcism theme. You play as Father Emmet and must purge all the evil from the Parabollam Village. To do this you will count on Father's Desmond help.

Go ahead and buy the game below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1444950/Demon_Purge_Saga/

The game for now have only the first 10 levels. On the official launch I plan to include more 60 levels.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Achievements + decreasing time + much more!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This big update changes some stuff in game. Many of these changes the community asked, others were already planned in the past. Here is the full list:

[list]
[*] Achievements!
[*] Decreasing time. You have 1 minute to play the match. Scoring can increase the time
[*] Mouse usage is back for menus. You can navigate using keyboard, mouse and controller all together
[*] More animations on the HUD
[*] Fixed some blocks not being movable
[*] Volume configuration on the title menu
[*] Full screen/windowed mode selection on the title menu
[*] Power-ups on the store not have descriptions
[*] Squirrel animations fix
[*] Removed the animation for score showing on game over
[*] Mouse will now be hidden when not used for more than 2s
[*] New main game backgrounds
[/list]

Hope you guys enjoy! :)

notes.title: Power-ups + coin system + new menus + score saver!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this new game update we have changed a lot in the overall game. The first thing we included was the Acorn Coins system. Now, after every match, you have the chance to collect these coins and use it on the new "Power-Up Store".

For now, the Power-Up Store offers 3 different specials: Rock Wand, Paper Wand and Scissor Wand. These power-ups can be used once during the match to convert all the blocks in the board to the corresponding special (ie: Rock Wand will convert all to Rock Blocks). As we publish more updates, more power-ups will come!

The Score Saver is a new feature also using the Acorn Coins. When you loose a match you will be able to spend some coins to keep your score in the next match! Raising even more the chance of getting new coins and reach new records.

All the menus in the game were also remade, making it easier to navigate using the keyboard or game controller. Instead of using the mouse, we can now navigate using the arrow keys or directional.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.3.0 - Brazilian portuguese support + multiple fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

In this update we included the support for the first additional language for the game: Brazilian portuguese. It's the studio's native language so it was easier to do it. Soon we will include support for more.

We also have fixed some issues with controls, included some visual improvements, improved the tutorial, improved the fullscreen mode, and other things.

Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 - Controller Support!
notes.notes:
We just launched the first update for Cut Smash Wrap! 

In this update we added the support for controllers usage. It should work with any known model of controller.

If you have any trouble please let us know.

Hope you like it!
